description: Generated from the Aetherius action registry (src/aetherius/core/actions/). Do not edit by hand: run 'make contracts'.

assert.summary: Fail the run unless a rendered condition is truthy.

params.name: condition
params.help: Expression that must be truthy.

params.name: message
params.help: Message shown when the assertion fails.

back.summary: Go back one entry in the browser history.

params.name: selector
params.help: Target element selector.

params.name: selector_type
params.help: How to read 'selector': css (default), xpath or text.

confirm.summary: Park the run until a human approves or rejects (console, daemon API, or notification).

params.name: message
params.help: What the human is being asked to approve.

params.name: title
params.help: Optional short title for the request.

params.name: timeout_ms
params.help: How long to wait for a decision before applying on_timeout (mandatory bound).

params.name: on_timeout
params.help: On expiry: 'approve', 'reject', or 'fail:CODE'. Deny-by-default.

params.name: channel
params.help: Optional notify channel to alert on: webhook, discord, telegram, ntfy.

params.name: target
params.help: Channel address for the alert (topic, chat id, webhook URL). Usually a secret.

params.name: config
params.help: Full channel config for multi-key channels; superset of 'target'.

params.name: level
params.help: Severity of the request notification: info, warning or error.

params.name: source
params.help: Selector to drag from.

params.name: target
params.help: Selector to drop onto.

emit.summary: Emit a progress event with a message.

params.name: message
params.help: Event message.

evaluate.summary: Run injected JavaScript in the page and return its result (Act II).

params.name: script
params.help: JavaScript expression or function.

params.name: arg
params.help: Optional argument passed to the script.

extract.summary: Read values from the current page's DOM into named outputs (Act II).

params.name: outputs
params.help: Map of output name to a selector spec (as: text/number/html/attr/list, or each/fields for records).

fill.summary: Set an input's value in one shot (clears it first).

params.name: selector
params.help: Target element selector.

params.name: value
params.help: Value to set.

params.name: selector_type
params.help: How to read 'selector': css (default), xpath or text.

for_each.summary: Run nested steps once per item.

params.name: items
params.help: Expression yielding the list to iterate.

params.name: as
params.help: Loop variable name (default: item).

params.name: steps
params.help: Steps to run per item.

forward.summary: Go forward one entry in the browser history.

hover.summary: Move the pointer over an element.

params.name: selector
params.help: Target element selector.

params.name: selector_type
params.help: How to read 'selector': css (default), xpath or text.

http.request.summary: Send an HTTP request and optionally extract from the response (Act I).

params.name: method
params.help: HTTP method.

params.name: url
params.help: Request URL.

params.name: headers
params.help: Request headers.

params.name: params
params.help: Query-string parameters.

params.name: form
params.help: URL-encoded form body (mutually exclusive with json).

params.name: json
params.help: JSON body (mutually exclusive with form).

params.name: expect
params.help: Response assertions.

params.name: extract
params.help: Named extractions from the response: from='json' (JSONPath), from='html' (CSS/XPath) or from='text' (the decoded body).

params.name: condition
params.help: Expression deciding the branch.

params.name: then
params.help: Steps to run when the condition holds.

params.name: else
params.help: Steps to run otherwise.

navigate.summary: Open a URL in the browser.

params.name: url
params.help: Absolute URL to open.

params.name: wait_until
params.help: Load state to wait for: load, domcontentloaded, networkidle or commit.

notify.summary: Send an alert to a notification channel (webhook, Discord, Telegram, ntfy).

params.name: channel
params.help: Channel kind: webhook, discord, telegram or ntfy (plugins may add more).

params.name: message
params.help: Alert body.

params.name: title
params.help: Optional alert title.

params.name: level
params.help: Severity: info, warning or error.

params.name: target
params.help: Channel address (webhook URL, chat id, topic). Usually a secret.

params.name: url
params.help: Optional deep link attached to the alert (the product page, ...).

params.name: config
params.help: Full channel config for multi-key channels; superset of 'target'.

optional.summary: Run nested steps whose failure is an acceptable outcome.

params.name: steps
params.help: Steps to attempt. On the first failure the rest are skipped and the run continues, reporting 'partial'.

press.summary: Press a keyboard key, optionally focused on an element.

params.name: key
params.help: Key name.

params.name: selector
params.help: Element to focus before pressing (optional).

params.name: selector_type
params.help: How to read 'selector': css (default), xpath or text.

read.summary: Read data off the screen described in natural language (Act III+).

params.name: vision
params.help: Natural-language description of the data to read.
params.placeholder: the list of prices in the results table

params.name: schema
params.help: JSON Schema of an object shaping the reply; omit for a free-form value returned under 'data'.

repeat.summary: Run nested steps a fixed number of times.

params.name: times
params.help: How many iterations.

params.name: steps
params.help: Steps to repeat.

screenshot.summary: Capture a screenshot artifact of the page or an element (Act II).

params.name: name
params.help: File name for the artifact (defaults to the step id).

params.name: selector
params.help: Element to capture; omit for the whole page.

params.name: full_page
params.help: Capture the full scrollable page when no selector is given.

params.name: selector_type
params.help: How to read 'selector': css (default), xpath or text.

scroll.summary: Scroll an element into view, or scroll the page by a delta.

params.name: selector
params.help: Element to scroll into view (optional).

params.name: dx
params.help: Horizontal wheel delta when no selector is given.

params.name: dy
params.help: Vertical wheel delta when no selector is given.

params.name: selector_type
params.help: How to read 'selector': css (default), xpath or text.

select.summary: Choose one or more options in a <select> element.

params.name: selector
params.help: Target element selector.

params.name: values
params.help: Option value(s) to select.

params.name: selector_type
params.help: How to read 'selector': css (default), xpath or text.

set.summary: Store a rendered value under this step's id, for later interpolation.

params.name: value
params.help: Value to store.

type.summary: Type text character by character (for fields that react to each keystroke).

params.name: selector
params.help: Target element selector.

params.name: text
params.help: Text to type.

params.name: delay_ms
params.help: Delay between keystrokes, in milliseconds.

params.name: selector_type
params.help: How to read 'selector': css (default), xpath or text.

upload.summary: Set the file(s) of a file input.

params.name: selector
params.help: Target element selector.

params.name: file
params.help: Path to the file to upload.

params.name: selector_type
params.help: How to read 'selector': css (default), xpath or text.

wait.summary: Pause for a fixed duration, or a random one drawn from a range.

params.name: ms
params.help: Milliseconds to wait.

params.name: min_ms
params.help: With max_ms and no ms: lower bound of a uniform random wait.

params.name: max_ms
params.help: With min_ms and no ms: upper bound of a uniform random wait.

wait_for.summary: Block until a selector reaches a state (Act II).

params.name: selector
params.help: Selector to wait for.

params.name: state
params.help: Target state: visible, attached, hidden or detached.

params.name: timeout_ms
params.help: Give up after this many milliseconds.

params.name: on_timeout
params.help: Named failure on timeout, e.g. 'fail:LOGIN_FAILED'.
